measurement.title: Gameplay road transactions: private candidate reuse, immutable geometry, spatial buckets and utility layout; warmed native 30000/50000 pairs
measurement.runtime: Native Unity Development Mono, unprofiled running paired windows; separate paused/raw/fine attribution and .NET10 x64 whole-state oracles
measurement.scenario: Existing 30000/7806-building/5230-active-car tick4800 input and existing 50005/13171-active-car diagnostic input. Legal two margin setup roads, add/connect-split/continuous and unchanged rejected edit cases. Snapshot hashes and active/tick ranges per run.
measurement.method: See Report.txt and measurements.csv. Normal host runs after load, setup, 8 seconds warmup and 60 normal frames. Main 30000 pairs final-a1/a2 versus draft-normal1/2; 50000 scale-a/a2 versus draft-scale1/2. Assertions and full serialization excluded from gameplay operation frames. Raw allocation and fine scopes are separate, inclusive ranges not added. Intermediate phases retained. No new expensive city generation.
limitations: profile.csv gc0/gc1/gc2 and route_preparations are legacy passed-zero placeholders, not measured zero; column units mark them accordingly. Native allocation scopes report -1 when unsupported; raw hierarchy is the allocation evidence.
Actual player pointer latency is unmeasured (-1). Scripted domain commands use real Player and normal Update, not a physical mouse.

Busy native widen/delete and deterministic busy reverse/cross often reject under unchanged old rules. Successful native growth-city edits are a separate functional validation, not busy-input performance cases.
Small bounded native sample count and short legal strokes; no universal O(local) or 16ms guarantee.
Some all-city iteration and complete vehicle validation remains; commute cost caches are conservatively invalidated on road changes.
Realtime runs finish at different ticks; full state equivalence is tested separately under deterministic same-runtime 240-step replay.
Initial/load/warmup times are present in separate phases, never headline acceptance timing.

Historical global --all --local audit can still fail the old mutable ManualCityPlayer asset from a prior package; this package registers versioned binaries only, and does not rewrite historical manifests.
